observation_source: Coordinator live no-follow probe of preserved candidate revision (same revision as run 30436771086). The pre-change validator in run 30436771086 did not capture the Location header in its detail output (detail=status=307 protected_redirect=false only). The coordinator independently probed the preserved candidate revision and captured the relative Location=/login?returnTo=%2Foperator, confirming same-origin relative redirect.

root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Validator prefix match rejected a valid same-origin relative Location. The old _is_safe_protected_redirect check used location.startswith(f"{web_url}/login?"), which requires an absolute URL prefixed by the candidate origin. A valid relative Location like /login?returnTo=%2Foperator does not start with the full https://candidate-...a.run.app/login? prefix and is therefore incorrectly rejected, producing protected_redirect=false.
root_cause_analysis.validator_evaluation: validate_cloud_run_live_deployment.py _is_safe_protected_redirect (before fix) required the Location header to be an absolute URL beginning with the candidate web_url origin. It did not resolve relative URLs against the request URL using urljoin, so a correct relative redirect was treated as a non-matching and thus unsafe Location.
root_cause_analysis.middleware_unchanged: apps/web/src/middleware.ts emits new URL('/login', request.url) — a same-origin relative Location — which is correct Next.js middleware behavior. No middleware change is required or introduced.

remediation.deployment_validator: Updated product_ops/deployment/validate_cloud_run_live_deployment.py _is_safe_protected_redirect to resolve the raw Location via urllib.parse.urljoin against the candidate request URL before validation. Absolute and relative same-origin redirects to /login?returnTo=/operator are both accepted. Scheme downgrade, host mismatch, port mismatch, external origin, protocol-relative, userinfo, fragment, hostile returnTo, and double-encoded returnTo are all rejected. Updated smoke_checks() to capture the raw Location header in report["web_operator_redirect"] and the check detail for diagnosability.
